items.html: And this drop, which is truly included of three drops, which are only the NHY of ZA, except that they were also included in HGT, this drop was given in the Chazeh of Aba, and he gave it in the secret of coupling to Ima, and there it became the phase of a small Vav within the Hey that is Ima, as is known, and is called a small Vav. It is divided into three points of drops, like this, which are the three drops of the Segol mentioned, and at the end of this Vav, at that thin tip, the Nukva of ZA came out, in the secret of a fourth step outward toward him, as mentioned above. For a large Vav has the numerical value of six, but a small Vav is only three; however, since they were also included in HGT in potential and not in actuality, it is therefore called by the name Vav, only that it is small.
